about-us.our-history-description: CDE Consultores was born from direct experience in health regulation and a clear need in the sector: to have expert and strategic advice that allows compliance with regulations without hindering business growth. Founded by former COFEPRIS officials and legal specialists, the firm understands regulatory processes and accompanies companies to prevent risks, avoid delays, and operate safely. Over the years, we have supported national and international companies in the pharmaceutical, medical device, food, cosmetic, and dietary supplement sectors in obtaining health registrations, health licenses, certifications, training, and import and export processes, becoming a reliable ally for operating in Mexico with certainty and compliance.

privacy-notice.header-title: COMPREHENSIVE PRIVACY NOTICE OF GRUPO CDE
privacy-notice.section-1-title: 1. IDENTITY AND DOMICILE OF THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY
privacy-notice.section-1-content:
Grupo CDE, domiciled in Mexico City, Mexico, in strict compliance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP) and its Regulations, is responsible for the use, processing, and protection of your personal data.

In this regard, we are committed to guaranteeing the privacy and the right to informational self-determination of our clients and prospects.
privacy-notice.section-2-content:
To carry out the purposes described in this privacy notice, we will collect and process the following personal identification and contact data:

 Full name
 Company
 Email address
 Phone number
 Position/Job Title

We inform you that Grupo CDE does not collect sensitive personal data for the purposes described herein.
privacy-notice.section-3-content:
Your personal data will be used for the following primary purposes, which are necessary for the service you request:

 Management, administration, and provision of our regulatory and sanitary consulting services.
 Formalization of contracts, billing, and follow-up on the commercial relationship.
 Response to inquiries, complaints, and comments related to our services.

Additionally, we will use your personal information for the following secondary purposes that are not strictly necessary but allow us to provide you with better service:

 Marketing, advertising, and commercial prospecting purposes.
 Sending newsletters, regulatory updates, and invitations to trade shows, food and tech industry summits, and exhibitions.

If you do not wish for your personal data to be used for these secondary purposes, you may indicate this by sending an email to privacidad@grupocde.com.
privacy-notice.section-4-content: We inform you that your personal data will not be sold, assigned, or transferred to third parties outside of Grupo CDE without your prior and express consent, except for the exceptions provided in Article 37 of the LFPDPPP, as well as upon request from competent authorities duly founded and motivated.
privacy-notice.section-5-content:
You have the right to know what personal data we hold about you, what we use it for, and the conditions of its use (Access). Likewise, it is your right to request the correction of your personal information if it is outdated, inaccurate, or incomplete (Rectification); that we remove it from our records or databases when you consider it is not being used properly (Cancellation); as well as to oppose the use of your personal data for specific purposes (Opposition).

To exercise any of the ARCO rights, you must submit the respective request via email to the following address: privacidad@grupocde.com.

Your request must contain:
1. Name of the owner and address or other means to communicate the response.
2. Documents proving your identity or, where appropriate, legal representation.
3. Clear and precise description of the data concerning which you seek to exercise an ARCO right.
privacy-notice.section-6-title: 6. USE OF TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES (COOKIES / WEB BEACONS)

We inform you that on our website we use cookies, web beacons, or other tracking technologies, through which it is possible to monitor your behavior as an internet user, as well as to provide you with a better service and experience when browsing our site.
